units.en: He was transferred to colonel of the archers who shoot at sound.
units.literal: He was transferred to Colonel of the Archers Who Shoot at Sound.

units.zh: 九年，復遣北使。
units.en: In the ninth year he was again sent as envoy to the north.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was again sent as envoy to the north.

units.zh: 昭明曰：「臣不欲競執關楗故耳。」
units.en: Zhaoming said, "Your servant did not wish to compete over holding the gate bars, that is all."
units.literal: Zhaoming said: "Your servant did not wish to compete over holding the gate bars, that is all."

units.zh: 昭明歷郡皆有勤績，常謂人曰：「人生何事須聚蓄，一身之外，亦復何須？
units.en: Zhaoming achieved diligent results in every commandery he served and often told people, "What in life requires hoarding? Beyond one's own person, what else is needed?
units.literal: Zhaoming in every commandery he served had diligent achievements; he often told people: "What in life requires hoarding? Beyond one's own person, what else is needed?

units.zh: 故終身不治產業。
units.en: Therefore he never managed property or estates throughout his life.
units.literal: Therefore throughout his life he did not manage property or estates.

units.zh: 子孫若不才，我聚彼散；
units.en: If one's descendants lack talent, what one gathers they will squander;
units.literal: If descendants lack talent, what I gather they will squander;

units.zh: 若能自立，則不如一經。」
units.en: If they can stand on their own, one classic is worth more than a fortune."
units.literal: If they can stand on their own, one classic is better than wealth."

units.zh: 中興二年，卒。
units.en: He died in the second year of Zhongxing.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing he died.

units.zh: 八歲，讀沈約集，見回文研銘，從典援筆擬之，便有佳致。
units.en: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works. Seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush to match it and at once produced something fine.
units.literal: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works; seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush and imitated it, and at once achieved fine effect.

units.zh: 景遣將任約擊梁湘東王於江陵，法和乃詣湘東乞征約，召諸蠻弟子八百人在江津，二日便發。
units.en: Jing sent his general Ren Yue to strike the Prince of Xiangdong at Jiangling; Fahe then went to the Prince of Xiangdong begging to campaign against Yue, mustered eight hundred barbarian disciples at the river crossing, and set out within two days.
units.literal: Jing sent his general Ren Yue to strike the Prince of Xiangdong at Jiangling; Fahe then went to the Prince of Xiangdong begging to campaign against Yue, mustered eight hundred barbarian disciples at the river crossing, and set out within two days.

units.zh: 至赤沙湖，與約相對，法和乘輕船，不介胄，沿流而下，去約軍一里乃還。
units.en: At Chisha Lake they faced Yue; Fahe took a light boat, wore no armor, drifted downstream, and turned back a li from Yue's army.
units.literal: At Chisha Lake they faced Yue; Fahe took a light boat, wore no armor, drifted downstream, and turned back a li from Yue's army.

units.zh: 湘東果釋用為郡守。
units.en: The Prince of Xiangdong indeed released him and employed him as commandery administrator.
units.literal: The Prince of Xiangdong indeed released him and employed him as commandery administrator.

units.zh: 約衆皆見梁兵步於水上，於是大潰，皆投水而死。
units.en: Yue's host all saw Liang infantry walking on the water; at that they broke utterly and threw themselves into the river to die.
units.literal: Yue's host all saw Liang infantry walking on the water; at that they broke utterly and threw themselves into the river to die.

units.zh: 約逃竄不知所之。
units.en: Yue fled and was lost to sight.
units.literal: Yue fled and was lost to sight.

units.zh: 如其言，果於水中見約抱剎仰頭，裁出鼻，遂擒之。
units.en: As he said, they indeed saw Yue in the water clinging to the shrine with head thrown back, only his nose above the surface; they seized him.
units.literal: As he said, they indeed saw Yue in the water clinging to the shrine with head thrown back, only his nose above the surface; they seized him.

units.zh: 約言求就師目前死，法和曰：「檀越有相，必不兵死，且於王有緣，決無他慮，王於後當得檀越力耳。」
units.en: Yue begged to die before the Master's eyes; Fahe said, "My patron has the look of fortune—he will surely not die by the sword; moreover he has karmic tie with the prince—set your mind at rest. The prince hereafter will gain my patron's strength."
units.literal: Yue begged to die before the Master's eyes; Fahe said: "My patron has the look of fortune—he will surely not die by the sword; moreover he has karmic tie with the prince—set your mind at rest. The prince hereafter will gain my patron's strength."

units.zh: 及魏圍江陵，約以兵赴救，力戰焉。
units.en: When Wei besieged Jiangling, Yue came with troops to the rescue and fought fiercely.
units.literal: When Wei besieged Jiangling, Yue came with troops to the rescue and fought fiercely.

units.zh: 法和旣平約，往進見王僧辯於巴陵，謂曰：「貧道已斷侯景一臂，其更何能為，檀越宜卽遂取。」
units.en: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said, "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once."
units.literal: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said: "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once."

units.zh: 乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。
units.en: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.
units.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 高祖異之，敕廷尉卿蔡法度曰：「吉翂請死贖父，義誠可嘉；
units.en: Gaozu was moved and ordered Minister of Justice Cai Fadu: "Ji Bin asks to die for his father—his loyalty is admirable;
units.literal: Gaozu marveled at it and ordered the Minister of Justice Cai Fadu, saying: "Ji Bin asks to die to redeem his father—the righteousness and sincerity are truly admirable;

units.zh: 法度受敕還寺，盛陳徽纏，備列官司，厲色問翂曰：「爾求代父死，敕已相許，便應伏法。
units.en: Fadu took the order, returned to court, spread out chains and fetters, lined up the officials, and sternly asked Bin: "You ask to die for your father—the edict already grants it; you should submit to execution.
units.literal: Fadu received the order and returned to his office; he displayed fetters and chains in profusion, arrayed the officials in full, and with stern countenance questioned Bin, saying: "You ask to die in your father's place—the edict has already granted it, and you ought to submit to the law.

units.zh: 法度知翂至心有在，不可屈撓，乃更和顏誘語之曰：「主上知尊侯無罪，行當釋亮。
units.en: Fadu saw Bin's heart could not be broken; he softened and said, "The throne knows your father is innocent and will free him soon.
units.literal: Fadu knew Bin's resolve was fixed and could not be bent; he changed to gentle persuasion and said, "The emperor knows your honored father is guiltless and will soon release him.

units.zh: 法度矜之，命脫其二械，更令著一小者。
units.en: Fadu took pity and had two removed, leaving only a lighter set.
units.literal: Fadu pitied him and ordered two bonds removed, allowing a lighter pair.

units.zh: 法度具以奏聞，高祖乃宥其父。
units.en: Fadu memorialized all of it; Gaozu then spared his father.
units.literal: Fadu reported everything in full; Gaozu then pardoned his father.

units.zh: 然刀鋸至劇，審能死不？
units.en: But blade and saw are cruel—can you truly die?
units.literal: Yet knife and saw are most severe—can you in truth face death?

units.zh: 且爾童孺，志不及此，必爲人所教。
units.en: You are only a boy; your heart cannot reach here—you were taught by someone.
units.literal: Moreover you are a mere child; your will does not reach to this—you must have been taught by someone.

units.zh: 姓名是誰，可具列答。
units.en: Name him—answer fully.
units.literal: What is his name—give a full list in answer.

units.zh: 若有悔異，亦相聽許。」
units.en: If you repent, we will hear it."
units.literal: If you repent and change your mind, that too will be allowed."

units.zh: 觀君神儀明秀，足稱佳童，今若轉辭，幸父子同濟。
units.en: You are bright and handsome, a model youth—turn back now and father and son may yet be spared.
units.literal: You look bright and noble—truly a fine youth. If you change your plea now, perhaps father and son may both be saved.

units.zh: 奚以此妙年，苦求湯鑊？」
units.en: Why at this tender age court the boiling cauldron?"
units.literal: Why in the flower of youth do you seek the cauldron and blade so bitterly?"

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 岱少與兄太子中舍人寅、新安太守鏡、征北將軍永、弟廣州刺史辨俱知名，謂之張氏五龍。
units.en: Young, Dai and his brothers—Yin, a crown-prince household court gentleman; Jing, administrator of Xin'an; Yong, general who pacifies the north; and the younger Bian, administrator of Guangzhou—were all celebrated; people spoke of the Zhang clan's Five Dragons.
units.literal: In youth Dai, with his elder brother Yin, crown prince household court gentleman, Jing, administrator of Xin'an, Yong, general who pacifies the north, and his younger brother Bian, administrator of Guangzhou, were all famed; men called them the Five Dragons of the Zhang clan.

units.zh: 寅、鏡名最高，永、辨、岱不及也。
units.en: Yin and Jing stood highest in renown; Yong, Bian, and Dai could not equal them.
units.literal: Yin and Jing had the highest fame; Yong, Bian, and Dai did not match them.

units.zh: 六年，爲軍師將軍，與西豊侯正德北伐渦陽，輒班師，爲有司所奏，免官削爵土。
units.en: In the sixth year he served as General of the Army and joined the Marquis of Xifeng, Zhengde, on a northern campaign against Woyang, but abruptly withdrew his forces. The authorities impeached him, and he was stripped of office and fief.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was made General of the Army and, with the Marquis of Xifeng, Zhengde, marched north against Woyang; he abruptly withdrew the army, was impeached by the responsible offices, and was stripped of office and fief.

units.zh: 彭城劉孝綽、河東裴子野、吳郡張嵊等每共論《周易》及《喪服》儀，酬應如響。
units.en: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.
units.literal: Pengcheng Liu Xiaochuo, Hedong Pei Ziye, Wu commandery Zhang Sheng, and others often debated the Book of Changes and mourning-garment ritual with him; his replies came like an echo.

units.zh: 侯景遣將宋子仙據郢州，琳攻剋之，擒子仙。
units.en: Hou Jing sent General Song Zixian to hold Yingzhou; Lin attacked and took it, capturing Zixian.
units.literal: Hou Jing sent General Song Zixian to hold Yingzhou; Lin attacked and took it, capturing Zixian.

units.zh: 梁蕭繹為周軍所逼，遣使告急，且請援。
units.en: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys begging aid.
units.literal: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys reporting emergency and requesting aid.

units.zh: 冬，詔岳為西南道大行臺，統司徒潘相樂等救江陵。
units.en: In winter an edict made Yue grand field headquarters of the southwest circuit, commanding minister of state Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.
units.literal: In winter an edict made Yue Grand Field Headquarters of the Southwest Circuit, commanding Minister of State Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.

units.zh: 夫以四子之行，屈平之材，然猶不能自顯而被刑戮，豈不足以觀哉！
units.en: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!
units.literal: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 語音傖重，膂力過人，便馬槊，事梁河東王蕭譽，以勇敢聞，譽板為府中兵參軍。
units.en: He spoke with a heavy northern accent, had uncommon strength, and fought well from horseback with the spear. He served Liang's Prince of Hedong, Xiao Yu, and won a name for bravery. Yu commissioned him military adjutant in the princely staff.
units.literal: His speech was thick with a northern accent; his physical strength surpassed other men; he was skilled with horse and spear; he served Liang's Prince of Hedong, Xiao Yu, and was known for courage; Yu appointed him by commission as military adjutant in the prince's establishment.

units.zh: 譽為廣州刺史，以鐵虎為興寧令。
units.en: When Yu became inspector of Guangzhou, he made Tiehu magistrate of Xingning.
units.literal: When Yu became Inspector of Guangzhou, he made Tiehu magistrate of Xingning.

units.zh: 譽拒戰，大捷，方等死，鐵虎功最，譽委遇甚重。
units.en: Yu fought back and won a crushing victory. Fangdeng was killed. Tiehu's merit stood first, and Yu relied on him ever more heavily.
units.literal: Yu resisted in battle and won a great victory; Fangdeng died; Tiehu's merit was foremost; Yu entrusted and favored him heavily.

units.zh: 侯景之亂，元帝於荊州遣世子方等代譽，且以兵臨之。
units.en: During Hou Jing's rebellion, Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jingzhou sent his heir Fangdeng to replace Yu and marched troops against him.
units.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion, Emperor Yuan at Jingzhou sent the heir Fangdeng to replace Yu and also advanced troops against him.

units.zh: 譽遷湘州，又為臨蒸令。
units.en: When Yu moved to Xiangzhou, Tiehu was again made magistrate of Linzheng.
units.literal: When Yu was transferred to Xiangzhou, Tiehu was again made magistrate of Linzheng.

units.zh: 及王僧辯討譽，於陣獲鐵虎，僧辯命烹之，鐵虎呼曰：「侯景未滅，柰何殺壯士。」
units.en: When Wang Sengbian attacked Yu, he took Tiehu on the field. Sengbian ordered him boiled alive. Tiehu shouted, "Hou Jing is not yet destroyed—why kill a fighting man?"
units.literal: When Wang Sengbian campaigned against Yu, he captured Tiehu in the battle line; Sengbian ordered him boiled alive; Tiehu cried out: "Hou Jing is not yet destroyed—how can you kill a stalwart?"
